d:
Siem samrat chaudhri ke samne prashant kishor pahunche to karyakram ke dauran ek dilchasp ghatnakram dekhne ko mila... tejasvi yadav ki kursi badli gaee aur mantri ramkripal yadav ko dusri jagah baithaya gaya... dekhie is pure ghatnakram ka vidiyo aur janie kya huaa mauke par.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
